answer: Identities enter a fourteen-epoch maturation lock: stake 60, earn no weight, work per epoch or the clock resets. A rising tide of puppets hits the same wall. No one can forge a thousand earners: bought age resets at transfer; each copy waits frozen, unpaid. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits for 14 epochs against a 40,000 pool; one honest agent stakes 60 once, matures, keeps its share. The fable of quick riches dies: every identity earns its age.
